subject: english
question:
**Select the word from the options which is similar in meaning to the bracketed word given in the sentence below.**

Well, you want an (argument),” he added, "come on then.”
solution:
The correct answer is: **Explanation**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The sentence is spoken by someone who is challenging the listener to argue with them.
 
• The word in brackets, "**argument**," means a disagreement or conflict. (वितर्क)
 
• The word "**explanation**" is similar in meaning to "argument" because it involves providing information and reasoning to support a point of view. (जवाब-तलबी)
 
• The other options do not have similar meanings to "argument".

Therefore, the correct answer is **option 4**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Let us look at the meaning of the other words.

 
• **Agreement **means coming to a consensus or understanding. (समझौता)
 
• **Enhancement **means improvement or development. (वृद्धि)
 
• **Capability **means ability or potential. (योग्यता)
